glosses: nutmeg (act of playing the ball through an opponent's legs)

examples.text: Der Zug fuhr durch einen Tunnel.
examples.en: The train went through a tunnel.

examples.text: Ich sah ein Licht am Ende des Tunnels.
examples.en: I saw a light at the end of the tunnel.

examples.text: Wie bist du in den Tunnel reingekommen?
examples.en: How did you get into the tunnel?

examples.text: Unser Zug durchquerte einen langen Tunnel.
examples.en: Our train went through a long tunnel.

examples.text: Endlich kam das Licht am Ende des Tunnels.
examples.en: At last there was light at the end of the tunnel.
